explanation: His nurse, Miss Prism, absent-mindedly put him in the bag and the manuscript of her three-volume novel in his baby carriage. The bag ended up at Victoria station.

claims.text: In The Importance of Being Earnest, Jack Worthing was found as a baby in a handbag.
Jack was not found in a hatbox, a laundry basket or on a church step.
Miss Prism, then in charge of the baby, absent-mindedly put him in a handbag and the manuscript of her three-volume novel in the perambulator.
The handbag was left in the cloakroom of Victoria station in London.
